content_items.arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
وَبِجَبرُوتِكَ الَّتِي غَلَبْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِي لا يَقُومُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ
وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي مَلأَتْ أَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَضَاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيٍْء
اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَهتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ
اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُغيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاءَ
اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَقْطَعُ الرََّّجَاءَ
اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ البَلاءَ
اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ وَكُلَّ خَطِيئَةٍ أَخْطَأْتُهَا
وَأَسْألُكَ بِجُودِكَ أَن تُدْنِيَنِي مِن قُرْبِكَ
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ خَاضِعٍ مُّتَذَلِّلٍ خَاشِعٍ أَن تُسَامِحَنِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي
وَتَجْعلَنِي بِقَسَمِكَ رَاضِياً قَانِعاً، وَفِي جَمِيعِ الأَحْوَاِل مُتَوَاضِعاً
اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
وَّلا لِشَيٍْء مِّنْ عَمَلِي الْقَبِيحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلاً غَيْرَكَ
وَسَكَنتُ إِلَي قَدِيمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِي وَمَنِّكَ عَلَيَّ
وَكَم مِّن فَاِدحٍ مِّنَ البَلاءِ أَقَلْتَهُ
وَكَم مِّن ثَنَاٍء جَمِيلٍ لَّسْتُ أَهْلاً لَّهُ نَشَرْتَهُ
وَخَدَعَتْنِي الدُّنْيَا بِغُرُورِهَا وَنَفْسِي بِجِنَايَتِهَا وَمِطَاِلي
يَا سَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ أَن لا يَحْجُبَ عَنْكَ دُعَائِي سُوءُ عَمَلِي وَفِعَاِلي
وَلا تَفْضَحَنِي بِخَفِيِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سِرِّي
وَلا تُعَاجِلْنِي بِالْعُقُوبَةِ عَلَى مَا عَمِلْتُهُ فِي خَلَوَاتِي
وَكُنِ اَللَّهُمَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ لِي فِي كُلِّ الأَحْوَاِل رَؤُوفاً
إِلَهِي وَرَبِّي مَن لِّي غَيْرُكَ أَسْألُهُ كَشْفَ ضُرِّي وَالْنَّظَرَ فِي أَمْرِي!
إِلَهِي وَمَوْلاي أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ حُكْماً اتَّبَعْتُ فِيهِ هَوَى نَفْسِي،
وَلَمْ أَحْتَرِسْ فِيهِ مِن تَزْيينِ عَدُوِّي،
فَغَرَّنِي بِمَا أَهْوَى وَأَسْعَدَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ القَضَاءُ
فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرَى عَلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُودِكَ
فَلَكَ الْحُجَّةُ عَلَيَّ فِي جَمِيعِ ذَلِكَ
وَلا حُجَّةَ لِي فِيمَا جَرَي عَلَيَّ فِيهِ قَضَاؤُكَ،
وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِي بَعْدَ تَقْصِيرِي وَإِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي
لا أَجِدُ مَفَرّاً مِّمَّا كَانَ مِنِّي
وَلا مَفْزَعاً أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ في أَمْرِي
غَيْرَ قَبُولِكَ عُذْرِي، وَإِدخَاِلكَ إِيَاي فِي سَعَةٍ مِّن رَّحْمَتِكَ
يَا رَبِّ ارْحَمْ ضَعْفَ بَدَنِي وَرِقَّةَ جِلْدِي وَدِقَّةَ عَظْمِي
يَا مَنْ بَدَأَ خَلْقِي وَذِكْرِي وَتَرْبِيَتِي وَبِرِّي وَتَغْذِيَتِي
هَبْنِي لابْتِدَاءِ كَرَمِكَ وَسَاِلفِ بِرِّكَ بِي
وَبَعْدَ مَا انْطَوَى عَلَيْهِ قَلْبِي مِن مَّعْرِفَتِكَ
وَبَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِي وَدُعَائِي خَاضِعاً لِّرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
هَيْهَاتَ أَنتَ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ أَن تُضَيِّعَ مَن رَّبَّيْتَهُ
أَوْ تُسْلِّمَ إِلىَ الْبلاءِ مَن كَفَيْتَهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ
وَلَيْتَ شِعْرِي يَا سَيِّدِي وَإِلَهِي وَمَوْلاي
أَتُسَلِّطُ النَّارَ عَلَى وُجُوهٍ خَرَّتْ لِعَظَمَتِكَ سَاجِدَةً
وَّعَلَى أَلْسُنٍ نَّطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ صَادِقَةً وَّبِشُكْرِكَ مَادِحَةً
وَّعَلَى ضَمَائِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ حَتَّى صَارَتْ خَاشِعَةً
وَّعَلَى جَواِرحَ سَعَتْ إِلَى أَوْطَانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طَائِعَةً وَّأَشَارَتْ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ مُذْعِنَةً
مَّا هَكَذَا الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَلا أُخْبِرْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنكَ
وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِي عَن قَلِيلٍ مِّن بَلاءِ الدُّنْيَا وَعُقُوبَاتِهَا،
وَمَا يَجْرِي فِيهَا مِنَ الْمَكَارِهِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا
عَلَى أَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَلاءٌ وَّمَكْرُوهٌ، قَلِيلٌ مَّكْثُهُ، يَسِيرٌ بَقَاؤُهُ، قَصِيرٌ مُّدَّتُهُ
فَكَيْفَ احْتِمَاِلي لِبَلاءِ الآخِرَةِ وَجَلِيلِ وُقُوعِ الْمَكَارِهِ فِيهَا!
وَهُوَ بَلاءٌ تَطُولُ مُدَّتُهُ، وَيَدُومُ مَقَامُهُ، وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ
لأَنَّهُ لا يَكُونُ إِلاَّ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ وَانتِقَامِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ
وَهَذَا مَا لا تَقُومُ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالأَرْضُ
وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعِيفُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتَكِينُ
فَهَبْنِي يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي وَرَبِّي صَبَرْتُ عَلَى عَذَابِكَ،
فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلَى كَرَامَتِكَ
أَمْ كَيْفَ أَسْكُنُ فِي النَّارِ وَرَجَائِي عَفْوُكَ
فَبِعِزَّتِكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي أُقْسِمُ صَادِقاً، لَئِن تَرَكْتَنِي نَاطِقاً
لأَضِجَّنَّ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِهَا ضَجِيجَ الآمِلِينَ
وَلأُنَادِيَنَّكَ أَيْنَ كُنتَ يَا وَلِيَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
أَفَتُرَاكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا إِلَهِي وَبِحَمْدِكَ، تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا صَوْتَ عَبْدٍ مُّسْلِمٍ
وَهُوَ يَضِجُّ إلَيْكَ ضَجِيجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ لِّرَحْمَتِكَ
يَا مَوْلاي فَكَيْفَ يَبقَى فِي الْعَذَابِ وَهُوَ يَرْجُو مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ
أَمْ كَيْفَ تُؤْلِمُهُ النَّارُ وَهُوَ يَامَلُ فَضْلَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
أَمْ كَيْفَ يُحْرِقُهُ لَهِيبُهَا وَأَنتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَتَرَى مَكَانَهُ
أَمْ كَيْفَ يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَفِيرُهَا وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفَهُ
أَمْ كَيْفَ يَتَقَلْقَلُ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ صِدْقَهُ
أَمْ كَيْفَ تَزْجُرُهُ زَبَانِيَتُهَا وَهُوَ يُنَادِيكَ يَا رَبَّهُ
أَمْ كَيْفَ يَرْجُو فَضْلَكَ فِي عِتْقِهِ مِنْهَا فَتَتْرُكُهُ فِيهَا
وَلا مُشْبِهٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِهِ الْمُوَحِّدِينَ مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ
فَبِالْيَقِينِ أَقْطَعُ لَوْلا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِهِ مِن تَعْذِيبِ جَاحِدِيكَ
وَمَا كَانَ لأَحَدٍ فِيهَا مَقَرّاً وَّلا مُقَاماً
لَّكِنَّكَ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُكَ أَقْسَمْتَ أَنْ تَمْلأَهَا مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ،
وَأَنتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدَئاً، وَّتَطَوَّلْتَ بِالإِنْعَامِ مُتَكَرِّماً:
أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُونَ
إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي قَدَّرْتَهَا
وَبِالْقَضِيَّةِ الَّتِي حَتَمْتَهَا وَحَكَمْتَهَا وَغَلَبْتَ مَنْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرَيْتَهَا
أَن تَهَبَ لِي، فِي هذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَفِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ
وَكُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ أَمَرْتَ بِإِثْبَاتِهَا الْكِرَامَ الكَاتِبِينَ
الَّذِينَ وَكَّلْتَهُم بِحِفْظِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنِّي
وَكُنتَ أَنتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيَّ مِن وَّرَائِهِمْ،
وَأَن تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي مِن كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تُنْزِلُهُ،
يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي وَمَاِلكَ رِقِّي
يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
أن تَجْعَلَ أَوْقَاتِي فِي اللَّيلِ وَالنَّهَارِ بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً،
حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَعْمَاِلي وَأَوْرَادِي كُلُّهَا وِرْداً وَّاحِداً،
يَا سَيِّدِي، يَا مَنْ عَلَيْهِ مُعَوَّلِي
يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
حَتَّى أَسْرَحَ إِلَيكَ فِي مَيَادِينِ السَّابِقِينَ
وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَحَسَنِ عَبِيدِكَ نَصِيباً عِنْدَكَ
فَإِنَّهُ لا يُنَالُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ بِفَضْلِكَ
وَاكْفِنِي شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي
اغْفِرْ لِمَن لا يَمْلِكُ إِلاَّ الدُّعَاءَ
وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَالأَئِمَّةِ الْمَيَامِينَ مِنْ آلِهِ

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which embraces all things;
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma in-ni as-aluka bi-rah-matikal-lati wasi`at kul-la shay

content_item_translations.translation_text: And by Your strength, through which You dominatest all things,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa bi-qu-watikal-lati qahar-ta biha kul-la shay

content_item_translations.translation_text: And toward which all things are humble
And before which all things are lowly;
And by Your invincibility through which You overwhelmest all things,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa bi-jabarutikal-lati ghalab-ta biha kul-la shay

content_item_translations.translation_text: And by Your might, which nothing can resist;
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa bi`izzatikal-lati la yaqumu laha shay

content_item_translations.translation_text: And by Your tremendousness, which has filled all things;
by Your force, which towers over all things;
And by Your face, which subsists after the annihilation of all things,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa bi-waj-hikal-baqi ba`da fana-i kul-li shay

content_item_translations.translation_text: And by Your Names, which have filled the foundations of all things;
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa bi-as-ma-ikal-lati malat ar-kana kul-li shay

content_item_translations.translation_text: And by Your knowledge, which encompasses all things;
And by the light of Your face, through which all things are illumined!
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa bi-nuri waj-hikal-ladhi ada-a lahu kul-lu shay

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Light! O All-holy!
O First of those who are first
And O Last of those who are last!
O Allah, forgive me those sins which tear apart safeguards!
O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down adversities!
O Allah, forgive me those sins which alter blessings!
O Allah forgive me those sins which hold back supplication!
O Allah forgive me those sins which cut down the hopes!
O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down tribulation!
O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed and every mistake I have made!
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma-igh-fir liya kul-la dham-bin adhnabtuhu wa kul-la khati-atin akh-tatuha

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah, verily I seek nearness to You through remembrance of You,
And I seek intercession from You with Yourself,
And I ask You through Your munificence to bring me near to Your proximity,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa as-aluka bi-judika an tud-ni-yani min qur-bik

content_item_translations.translation_text: And to provide me with gratitude toward You
And to inspire me with Your remembrance.
O Allah, verily I ask You with the asking of a submissive, abased and lowly man to show me forbearance, to have mercy on me
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma in-ni as-luka suala khadii'm-mutadhal-lilin kha-shii'n an tusamihani wa tar-hamani

content_item_translations.translation_text: And to make me satisfied and content with Your appointment and [make me] humble in every state.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa taj-`alani bi-qasamika radiyan qani`n wa fi jamii'l-ah-wali mutawadi`aa

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah, I ask You the question of one whose indigence is extreme,
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma wa as-aluka suala manish-tad-dat faqatuh

content_item_translations.translation_text: And who has stated to You in difficulties his need
And whose desire for what is with You has become great.
O Allah, Your force is tremendous, Your place is lofty,
And Your plan is hidden, Your command is manifest,
And Your domination is overwhelming, Your power is unhindered
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ghalaba qah-ruka wa jarat qud-ratuk

content_item_translations.translation_text: And escape from Your governance is impossible.
O Allah, I find no forgiver of my sins,
Nor concealer of my ugly acts
Nor transformer of any of my ugly acts into good acts but You
There is no god but You!
Glory be to You, and Thine is the praise!
I have wronged myself,
And I have been audacious in my ignorance
And I have depended upon Your ancient remembrance of me and Your favour toward me.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa sakan-tu ila qadimi dhik-rika li wa man-nika `alay

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah! O my Protector!
How many ugly things You hast concealed!
How many burdensome tribulations You hast abolished!
And how many stumbles You hast prevented!
And how many ordeals You hast repelled!
And how much beautiful praise, for which I was unworthy, You hast spread abroad!
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa kam-min thana-in jamilil-las-tu ah-lal-lahu nashar-tah

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah, my tribulation is tremendous,
And my bad state is excessive,
And my acts are inadequate,
And my fetters have tied me down,
And my far-fetched hopes have held me back from my gain
And this world with its delusions, my own soul with its offences and my delay have deceived me.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa khada`at-nid-dunya bi-ghururi-ha wa naf-si bi-jinayatiha wa mita-li

content_item_translations.translation_text: O my Master! So I ask You by Your might not to let my evil works and acts veil my supplication from You,
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya say-yidi fa-as-aluka bi-i'z-zatika an la yah-juba `an-ka du`aa-i suo-u `amali wa fi`ali

content_item_translations.translation_text: And not to disgrace me through the hidden things You knowest of my secrets
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa-la taf-dah-ni bi-khafi-yi mat-tala`ta `ailayhi min sir-ri

content_item_translations.translation_text: And not to hasten me to punishment for what I have done in private:
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa-la tu`ajil-ni bil-u'qubati `ala ma `amil-tuhu fi khalawati

content_item_translations.translation_text: My evil acts in secrecy and my misdeeds
And my continuous negligence and my ignorance
And my manifold passions and my forgetfulness.
And by Your might, O Allah, be kind to me in all states
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa kunil-lahumma bi-i'z-zatika li fi kul-lil-ah-wali ra’ufa

content_item_translations.translation_text: And be gracious to me in all affairs!
My God and my Lord! Have I any but You from whom to ask removal of my affliction and regard for my affairs!
content_item_translations.transliteration: ilahi wa rab-bi mal-li ghayruka as-aluhu kash-fa dur-ri wan-nazara fi am-ri!

content_item_translations.translation_text: My God and my Protector! You put into effect through me a decree in which I followed the caprice of my own soul
content_item_translations.transliteration: ilahi wa maw-laya aj-rayta `alay-ya huk-mant-taba`tu fihi hawa naf-si

content_item_translations.translation_text: And [I] did not remain wary of adorning my enemy.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa lam ah-taris fihi min tazyini `adu-wi

content_item_translations.translation_text: So he deluded me through my soul's caprice and therein destiny favoured him
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa-ghar-rani bi-ma ah-wa wa as-`adahu `ala dha-likal-qada

content_item_translations.translation_text: So, in what was put into effect through me in that situation, I transgressed some of Your statutes
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa-taja-waztu bi-ma jara `alay-ya min dha-lika ba`da hududik

content_item_translations.translation_text: And disobeyed some of Your commands.
So Thine is the argument against me in all of that
I have no argument in what Your destiny put into effect through me therein
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa-la huj-jata li fima jara `alay-ya fihi qadauka

content_item_translations.translation_text: nor in what Your decree and Your tribulation imposed upon me.
Now I have come to You, My God, after my shortcoming and my immoderation toward myself,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qad ataytuka ya ilahi ba`da taq-siri wa is-rafi `ala naf-si

content_item_translations.translation_text: Proffering my excuse, regretful,
Broken, apologizing,
Asking forgiveness, repenting,
Acknowledging, submissive, confessing.
I find no place to flee from what occurred through me,
Nor any place of escape to which I may turn in my affairs,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa-la mafza'an atawaj-jahu ilayhi fi am-ri

content_item_translations.translation_text: Other than Your acceptance of my excuse and Your entering me into the compass of Your mercy.
content_item_translations.transliteration: ghayra qabulika u'dhri wa id-khalika i-yaya fi sa'tim-mir-rah-matik

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah, so accept my excuse,
Have mercy upon the severity of my affliction
And release me from the tightness of my fetters,
My Lord, have mercy upon the weakness of my body, the thinness of my skin and the frailty of my bones.
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya rab-bir-ham da`fa badani wa riq-qata jil-di wa diq-qata `azmi

content_item_translations.translation_text: O You who gave rise to my creation, to the remembrance of me, to the nurture of me, to goodness toward me and to nourishment on me,
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya mam bada khal-qi wa dhik-ri wa tar-bi-yati wa biri wa tagh-dhi-yati

content_item_translations.translation_text: Bestow upon me for the sake of Your having given rise [to me] with generosity and Your previous goodness to me!
content_item_translations.transliteration: hab-ni lb-tida-i karamika wa salifi bir-rika bi

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah, my Master and my Lord!
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya ilahi wa say-yidi wa rab-bi

content_item_translations.translation_text: Canst You see Yourself tormenting me with Your fire after I have professed Your Unity
And after the knowledge of You my heart has embraced,
And the remembrance of You my tongue has constantly mentioned
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa lahija bihi lisani min dhik-rik

content_item_translations.translation_text: And the love of You to which my mind has clung,
And after the sincerity of my confession and my supplication, humble before Your lordship?
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ba`da sid-qi-`a-tirafi wa du`aa-i khadi`aal-li-rububi-yatika

content_item_translations.translation_text: Far be it from You! You art more generous than that You shouldst squander him whom You hast nurtured,
content_item_translations.transliteration: hayhata anta ak-ramu min an tuday-yi`a mar-rab-baytah

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or banish him whom You hast brought nigh,
Or drive away him whom You hast given an abode
Or submit to tribulation him whom You hast spared and shown mercy.
content_item_translations.transliteration: aw tus-s-lima ilal-bala-i man kafay-tahu wa rahim-tah

content_item_translations.translation_text: Would that I knew, my Master, My God and my Protector,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa layta shi`a-ri yay say-yidi wa ilahi wa maw-lay

content_item_translations.translation_text: Whether You wilt give the Fire dominion over faces fallen down prostrate before Your Tremendousness,
And over tongues voicing sincerely the profession of Your Unity and giving thanks to You in praise,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa `ala al-sunin-nataqat bi-taw-hidika sadiqataw-wa bishuk-rika madihah

content_item_translations.translation_text: And over hearts acknowledging Your Divinity through verification,
And over minds encompassing knowledge of You until they have become humble
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa `ala dama-ira hawat minal-i'l-mi bika hat-ta sarat khashi`ah

content_item_translations.translation_text: And over bodily members speeding to the places of Your worship in obedience and beckoning for Your forgiveness in submission.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa `ala jawariha sa't ila aw-tani ta'b-budika ta-i`ataw-wa asharat bis-tigh-farika mudhi'nah

content_item_translations.translation_text: No such opinion is held of You! Nor has such been reported - thanks to Your bounty — concerning You,
content_item_translations.transliteration: ma hkadhaz-zan-nu bika wa-la ukh-bir-na bi-fadlika `anka

content_item_translations.translation_text: O All-generous! My Lord,
And You knowest my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and punishments,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa anta ta`lamu da`fi `an qalilim-min bala-id-dun-ya wa u'qubatiha

content_item_translations.translation_text: And before those ordeals which befall its inhabitants,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ma yaj-ri fiha minal-makarihi `ala ah-liha

content_item_translations.translation_text: Even though it is a tribulation and ordeal whose stay is short, whose subsistence is but little and, whose period is but fleeting.
content_item_translations.transliteration: `ala an-na dha-lika bala-uw-wa mak-ruhun, qalilum-mak-thuhu, yasirum baqa-uhu, qasirum-mud-datuh

content_item_translations.translation_text: So how can I endure the tribulations of the next world and the great ordeals that occur within it?
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa-kayfah-timali li-bala-il-akhirati wa jalili wuqui'l-makarihi fiha!

content_item_translations.translation_text: For it is a tribulation whose period is long, whose station endures and whose sufferers are given no respite,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa huwa bala-un tatulu mud-datuhu, wa yadumu maqamuhu, wa-la yukhaf-fafu `an ah-lih

content_item_translations.translation_text: Since it only occurs as a result of Your wrath, Your vengeance and Your anger,
content_item_translations.transliteration: li-an-nahu la yakunu il-la `an ghadabika wan-tiqamika wa sakhatik

content_item_translations.translation_text: And these cannot be withstood by the heavens and the earth.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa hadha ma la taqumu lahus-samawatu wal-ardu

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Master, so what about me?!
For I am Your weak, lowly, base, wretched and miserable slave.
My God! My Lord! My Master! My Protector!
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya ilahi wa rab-bi wa say-yidi wa maw-lay

content_item_translations.translation_text: For which things would I complain to You?
And for which of them would I lament and weep?
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa lima minha adij-ju wa ab-ki

content_item_translations.translation_text: For the pain and severity of chastisement?
Or for the length and period of tribulation?
So if You takest me to the punishments with Your enemies,
And gatherest me with the people of Your tribulation
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa jama`ta bayni wa bayna ahli bala-ik

content_item_translations.translation_text: And separatest me from Your friends and saints,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa far-raq-ta bay-ni wa bay-na ahib-ba-ika wa aw-li-ya-ik

content_item_translations.translation_text: Then suppose, My God, my Master, my Protector and my Lord that I am able to endure Your chastisement,
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa-hab-ni ya ilahi wasay-yidi wa mawlaya wa rab-bi sabar-tu `ala `adhabika

content_item_translations.translation_text: How can I endure separation from You?
And suppose that I am able to endure the heat of Your fire,
How can I endure not gazing upon Your generosity?
Or how can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is Your pardon?
content_item_translations.transliteration: am kayfa as-kunu fin-nari wa raja-i `af-wuk

content_item_translations.translation_text: So by Your might, my Master and my protector, I swear sincerely, if You leavest me with speech,
content_item_translations.transliteration: fabi-i'z-zatika ya say-yidi wa mawlaya uq-simu sadiqal-la-in tarak-tani natiqan

content_item_translations.translation_text: I will lament to You from the midst of the Fire's inhabitants with lamentation of the hopeful;
I will cry to You with the cry of those crying for help;
I will weep to You with the weeping of the bereft;
And I will call to You, Where art You, O Sponsor of the believers,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa la-unadi-yan-naka ay-na kun-ta ya wali-yal-mu-minin

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Goal of the hopes of Your knowers,
O Aid of those who seek assistance,
O Friend of the hearts of the sincere
And O God of all the world's inhabitants!
Canst You see Yourself — Glory be to You My God, and Thine is the praised — hearing within the Fire the voice of a slave surrendered to You,
content_item_translations.transliteration: afaturaka sub-hanaka ya ilahi wa biham-dika tas-mau' fiha saw-ta `ab-dim-mus-limin

content_item_translations.translation_text: Imprisoned there because of his violations,
Tasting the favour of its torment because of his disobedience,
And confined within its levels because of his sin and crime,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa hubisa bayna at-baqiha bijur-mih wa jariratih

content_item_translations.translation_text: While he laments to You with the lament of one hopeful for Your mercy,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa huwa yadij-ju ilayka dajija muammilil-lirah-mat-k

content_item_translations.translation_text: And calls to You with the tongue of those who profess Your Unity
And entreats You by Your lordship!
My Protector, so how should he remain in the chastisement, while he has hope for Your previous clemency?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya mawlay fa-kayfa yabqa fil-`adhabi wa huwa yar-ju ma salafa min hil-mik

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or how should the Fire cause him pain while he expects Your bounty and mercy?
content_item_translations.transliteration: am kayfa tu-limuhun-naru wa huwa ya-malu fadlaka wa rah-mataka

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or how should its flames burn him, while You hearest his voice and seest his place?
content_item_translations.transliteration: am kayfa yuh-riquhu lahibuha wa anta tas-mau' saw-tahu wa tara makanah

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or how should its groaning encompass him, while You knowest his weakness?
content_item_translations.transliteration: am kayfa yash-tamilu `ailayhi zafiruha wa anta ta`lamu da`fah

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or how should he be convulsed among its levels, while You knowest his sincerity?
content_item_translations.transliteration: am kayfa yataqalqalu bayna at-baqiha wa anta ta`lamu sid-qah

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or how should its keepers torture him while he calls out to You, O Lord?
content_item_translations.transliteration: am kayfa tazjuruhu zabani-yatuha wa huwa yunadika ya rab-bah

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or how should he have hope of Your bounty in freeing him from it, while You abandonest him within it?
content_item_translations.transliteration: am kayfa yar-ju fadlaka fi i't-qihi minha fatat-rukuhu fiha

content_item_translations.translation_text: Far be it from You! That is not what is expected of You,
Nor what is well-known of Your bounty,
Nor it is similar to the goodness and kindness You hast shown to those who profess Your Unity.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa-la mush-biha lima `amal-ta bihil-muah-hidina mim bir-rika wa ih-sanik

content_item_translations.translation_text: So I declare with certainty that were it not for what You hast decreed concerning the chastisement of Your deniers
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa-bial-yaqini aq-tau' law-la ma hakam-ta bihi min ta`dhibi jahidik

content_item_translations.translation_text: And what You hast foreordained concerning the everlasting home of those who stubbornly resist,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qadayta bihi min ikh-laydi mu`anidik

content_item_translations.translation_text: You wouldst make the Fire, all of it, coolness and safety,
And no one would have a place of rest or abode within it.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ma kana li-ahadin fiha maqar-raw-wa-la muqama

content_item_translations.translation_text: But You—holy are Your Names—hast sworn that You wilt fill it with the unbelievers,
content_item_translations.transliteration: lakin-naka taqad-dasat as-ma-uka aq-sam-ta an tam-laha minal-kafirina;

content_item_translations.translation_text: Both Jinn and men together,
And that You wilt place those who stubbornly resist therein forever.
And You— majestic is Your eulogy— said at the beginning and wernt gracious through kindness as a favour,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa anta jal-la thana-uka qul-ta mub-tadiwaw-wa tataw-wal-ta bil-in-`ami mutakar-rima

content_item_translations.translation_text: (What? Is he who has been believer like unto him who has been ungodly? They are not equal)
content_item_translations.transliteration: afaman kana muminan kaman kana fasiqal-la yas-tawun

content_item_translations.translation_text: My God and my Master! So I ask You by the power You hast apportioned
content_item_translations.transliteration: ilahi wa say-yidi fa-as-aluka bial-qud-ratil-lati qad-dartaha

content_item_translations.translation_text: And by the decision which You hast determined and imposed and through which You hast overcome him toward whom it has been put into effect,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa bil-qadi-yatil-lati hatam-taha wa hakam-taha wa ghalab-ta man `ailayhi aj-raytaha

content_item_translations.translation_text: That You forgivest me in this night and at this hour
content_item_translations.transliteration: an tahaba li fi hadhihil-laylati wa fi hadhihis-sa'ah

content_item_translations.translation_text: Every offence I have committed,
And every sin I have performed,
And every ugly thing I have concealed
And every folly I have enacted
Whether I have hidden or announced it,
Or I have concealed it or manifested it
And every evil act which You hast commanded the Noble Writers to record,
Those whom You hast appointed to watch over what appears from me
content_item_translations.transliteration: al-ladhina wak-kal-tahum bi-hif-zi ma yakunu min-ni

content_item_translations.translation_text: And whom You hast made, along with my bodily members, witness against me.
And You wast Yourself the Watcher over me from behind them,
And the Witness of what is hidden from them
But through Your mercy You concealed it
And through Your bounty You veiled it.
[And I ask You] that You bestowest upon me an abundant share of every good You sendest down,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa an tuwf-fira haz-zi min kul-li khayrin tunziluh

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or kindness You conferrest,
Or goodness You unfoldest,
Or provision You spreadest out,
Or sin You forgivest,
Or error You coverest.
My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya rab-bi ya rabb

content_item_translations.translation_text: My God! My Master! My Protector! Owner of my bondage!
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya ilahi wa say-yidi wa maw-laya wa malika riq-qi

content_item_translations.translation_text: O He in whose hand is my forelock!
O He who knows my affliction and my misery!
O He who is aware of my poverty and indigence!
My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya ya rab-bi ya rabb

content_item_translations.translation_text: I ask You by Your Truth and Your Holiness
And the greatest of Your Attributes and Names,
That You makest my times in the night and the day inhabited by Your remembrance,
content_item_translations.transliteration: an taj-`ala aw-qati fil-layli wan-nahari bi-dhik-rika ma`murah

content_item_translations.translation_text: And joined to Your service
And my works acceptable to You,
So that my works and my litanies may all be a single litany
content_item_translations.transliteration: hat-ta takuna a`mali wa aw-radi kul-luha wir-daw-wahidan

content_item_translations.translation_text: And my occupation with Your service everlasting.
My Master! O He upon whom I depend!
O He to whom I complain about my states!
My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
content_item_translations.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya rab-bi ya rabb

content_item_translations.translation_text: Strengthen my bodily members in Your service,
And fortify my ribs in determination
And bestow upon me earnestness in my fear of You
And continuity in my being joined to Your service
So that I may move easily toward You in the battlefields of the foremost
And hurry to You among the prominent
And desire fervently Your proximity among the fervently desirous
And move nearer to You with the nearness of the sincere
And fear You with the fear of those who have certitude
And gather with the believers in Your vicinity.
O Allah, whoever desires evil for me, desire [it] for him!
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma wa man aradani bisuo-in farid-hu

content_item_translations.translation_text: whoever deceives me-deceive him!
And make me one of the most excellent of Your slaves in Portion from You,
And the nearest of them in station to You
And the most elected of them in proximity to You.
For that cannot be attained except by Your bounty.
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa-in-nahu la yunalu dha-lika il-la bi-fadlik

content_item_translations.translation_text: And grant generously to me through Your munificence,
And incline toward me with Your splendour
And protect me with Your mercy!
And make my tongue remember You without ceasing
And my heart enthralled by Your love!
And be gracious to me by answering me favourably,
And nullify my slips
And forgive my lapses!
For You hast decreed Your worship for Your servants
And commanded them to supplicate You
And assured them that they would be answered.
So toward You, my Lord, I have turned my face
And toward You, my Lord, I have extended my hand.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ilayka ya rab-bi madad-tu yadi

content_item_translations.translation_text: So by Your might, comply with my supplication
And make me attain my desires!
Do not severe my hoping for Your Favours
And spare me the evil of my enemies from among the jinn and men!
O He, whose pleasure is quickly achieved!
Forgive him who owns nothing but supplication
For You dost what You wilt.
O He whose Name is a remedy,
And whose remembrance is a cure,
And whose obedience is wealth!
Have mercy upon him whose capital is hope
And whose weapon is tears!
O Ample in blessings!
O Repeller of adversities!
O Light of those who are lonely in the darkness!
O Knower who was never taught!
Bless Muhammad and Muhammad's household!
And do with me what is worthy of You!
And Allah bless His messenger and the holy Imams of his household
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa sal-lallahu `ala rasulihi wal-aimmatil-mayamina min a-lihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: And give them abundant peace!
